<?php
/**
 * Petshop_Feeding_Repository — READ-ONLY.
 * Skaito ps_feeding, tikrina runtime invariantą, normalizuoja DB tipus į Calculator sutartį.
 * NIEKO neskaičiuoja. NIEKO nerašo. Nesirenka „pirmo pasitaikiusio" mappingo.
 *
 * Runtime invariantas aktyviai lentelei:
 *   status='verified' AND is_active=1 AND canonical_table_hash IS NOT NULL AND map.is_active=1
 *   aktyvių tinkamų = tiksliai 1 (0 -> NO_ACTIVE_FEEDING_TABLE, >1 -> DATA_INTEGRITY_ERROR)
 *
 * SUPPORT klasifikacija (sąžininga — NE pritempimas prie Calculator):
 *   calculator_supported   — Calculator moka be papildomos ašies (svorio taškai/intervalai/interpol.)
 *   calculator_partial     — reikia kategorinės ašies iš profilio; be jos negalima
 *   unsupported_structure  — multi_axis_grid pilnas / interpolation_pending / unsupported
 *   empty_by_design        — canonical_table_hash NULL (4 tuščios)
 *   repository_error       — invarianto pažeidimas ar DB anomalija
 */
class Petshop_Feeding_Repository {

	const EXPECTED_HASH_VERSION = 'chash_v1';

	/** wpdb injekcija testams; produkcijoj — global $wpdb. */
	protected $db;
	protected $pf;

	public function __construct( $wpdb = null ) {
		if ( $wpdb === null ) { global $wpdb; }
		$this->db = $wpdb;
		$this->pf = $wpdb->prefix;
	}

	/**
	 * Grąžina VIENĄ aktyvią lentelę produktui pagal runtime invariantą.
	 * @return array su 'status' => OK|NO_ACTIVE_FEEDING_TABLE|DATA_INTEGRITY_ERROR|EMPTY_TABLE_CONTENT
	 */
	public function get_for_product( $product_id ) {
		$product_id = (int) $product_id;
		$T = $this->pf.'ps_feeding_tables';
		$M = $this->pf.'ps_feeding_map';

		// runtime invariantas — jokio LIMIT 1
		$rows = $this->db->get_results( $this->db->prepare(
			"SELECT t.* FROM {$M} m
			 JOIN {$T} t ON t.id = m.feeding_table_id
			 WHERE m.product_id = %d AND m.is_active = 1
			   AND t.is_active = 1 AND t.status = 'verified'
			   AND t.canonical_table_hash IS NOT NULL",
			$product_id ), ARRAY_A );

		$n = is_array($rows) ? count($rows) : 0;
		if ( $n === 0 ) {
			return array('status'=>'NO_ACTIVE_FEEDING_TABLE','product_id'=>$product_id);
		}
		if ( $n > 1 ) {
			$ids = array_map(function($r){ return (int)$r['id']; }, $rows);
			return array('status'=>'DATA_INTEGRITY_ERROR','product_id'=>$product_id,
				'table_ids'=>$ids,'note'=>'daugiau nei 1 aktyvus verified mappingas');
		}

		$t = $rows[0];
		return $this->build_table_payload( $t, $product_id );
	}

	/** Sukuria pilną payload (metaduomenys + eilutės) iš lentelės įrašo. */
	protected function build_table_payload( array $t, $product_id ) {
		$table_id = (int) $t['id'];

		// hash versijos patikra
		if ( ($t['canonical_hash_version'] ?? null) !== self::EXPECTED_HASH_VERSION ) {
			return array('status'=>'HASH_VERSION_MISMATCH','table_id'=>$table_id,'product_id'=>$product_id,
				'got'=>$t['canonical_hash_version'] ?? null,'expected'=>self::EXPECTED_HASH_VERSION);
		}

		$R = $this->pf.'ps_feeding_rows';
		$raw = $this->db->get_results( $this->db->prepare(
			"SELECT row_order, weight_from_kg, weight_to_kg, amount_from_g, amount_to_g,
			        condition_dimensions, cell_type, redirect_reason, source_label
			 FROM {$R} WHERE feeding_table_id = %d ORDER BY row_order ASC", $table_id ), ARRAY_A );

		if ( ! is_array($raw) || ! count($raw) ) {
			return array('status'=>'EMPTY_TABLE_CONTENT','table_id'=>$table_id,'product_id'=>$product_id,
				'note'=>'verified lentele be eiluciu — integralumo anomalija');
		}

		// DB tipų normalizavimas į Calculator sutartį (NULL lieka NULL, decimal -> float)
		$rows = array();
		foreach ( $raw as $r ) {
			$cond = array();
			if ( ! empty($r['condition_dimensions']) ) {
				$j = json_decode( $r['condition_dimensions'], true );
				if ( is_array($j) ) { $cond = $j; }
			}
			$rows[] = array(
				'cell_type'       => $r['cell_type'],
				'weight_from_kg'  => $this->dec($r['weight_from_kg']),
				'weight_to_kg'    => $this->dec($r['weight_to_kg']),
				'amount_from_g'   => $this->dec($r['amount_from_g']),
				'amount_to_g'     => $this->dec($r['amount_to_g']),
				'redirect_reason' => $r['redirect_reason'],   // NULL lieka NULL
				'source_label'    => $r['source_label'],
				'conditions'      => $cond,                    // Calculator raktas
			);
		}

		$axis_policy = array();
		if ( ! empty($t['axis_resolution_policy']) ) {
			$j = json_decode( $t['axis_resolution_policy'], true );
			if ( is_array($j) ) { $axis_policy = $j; }
		}
		// fallback: jei axis_resolution_policy tuščias, statom iš resolution_policy svorio ašiai
		if ( ! count($axis_policy) && ! empty($t['resolution_policy']) ) {
			$wkey = ($t['weight_basis']==='adult_expected') ? 'adult_expected_weight_kg' : 'current_weight_kg';
			$axis_policy[$wkey] = $t['resolution_policy'];
		}

		$support = $this->classify_support( $t );

		return array(
			'status'                 => 'OK',
			'support'                => $support,     // calculator_supported|calculator_partial|unsupported_structure
			'table_id'               => $table_id,
			'product_id'             => (int) $product_id,
			'brand'                  => $t['brand'],
			'line'                   => $t['line'],
			'weight_basis'           => $t['weight_basis'],
			'row_dimension'          => $t['row_dimension'],
			'source_structure'       => $t['source_structure'],
			'resolution_policy'      => $t['resolution_policy'],
			'b_path_status'          => $t['b_path_status'],
			'axis_policy'            => $axis_policy,
			'canonical_hash_version' => $t['canonical_hash_version'],
			'source_version'         => $t['source_version'],
			'value_row_count'        => isset($t['value_row_count']) ? (int)$t['value_row_count'] : null,
			'redirect_row_count'     => isset($t['redirect_row_count']) ? (int)$t['redirect_row_count'] : null,
			'rows'                   => $rows,
		);
	}

	/**
	 * SĄŽININGA support klasifikacija. NE „viskas supported".
	 * Sprendžiama iš row_dimension + source_structure + resolution_policy.
	 */
	public function classify_support( array $t ) {
		$ss = $t['source_structure'] ?? null;
		$rp = $t['resolution_policy'] ?? null;
		$rd = $t['row_dimension'] ?? null;
		$bp = $t['b_path_status'] ?? null;

		// unsupported struktūros
		if ( $ss === 'unsupported' || $rp === 'unsupported' ) return 'unsupported_structure';
		if ( $rp === 'interpolation_pending' ) return 'unsupported_structure';

		// multi_axis_grid: pilnas grid = dar nepalaikoma; partial = partial
		if ( $ss === 'multi_axis_grid' ) {
			return ($bp === 'full') ? 'unsupported_structure' : 'calculator_partial';
		}

		// grynas svoris (weight ašis, discrete/range) — Calculator moka be papildomos ašies
		if ( $rd === 'weight' && ($ss === 'discrete_points' || $ss === 'range') ) {
			return 'calculator_supported';
		}

		// amžiaus ašis — Calculator svorio kelias tam netinka be amžiaus lookup
		if ( $rd === 'age' ) return 'calculator_partial';

		// kategorinės ašys (body_condition, activity_level, lifestyle, svorio_valdymas)
		// Calculator moka TIK jei profilis paduos ašį; be jos negalima → partial
		if ( in_array($rd, array('body_condition','activity_level','lifestyle','svorio_valdymas'), true) ) {
			return 'calculator_partial';
		}

		// row_dimension NULL su turiniu — neaišku, partial (saugiau nei supported)
		return 'calculator_partial';
	}

	/** decimal(x,y) NULL -> NULL; kitaip float (NEvirsta 0, NEvirsta tekstu). */
	protected function dec( $v ) {
		if ( $v === null ) return null;
		if ( $v === '' ) return null;
		return (float) $v;
	}
}
